summary_1line: The Pandavas live in exile at Dwaita while a Brahmana reports their suffering to Dhritarashtra, who laments his sons’ wrongdoing and fears destiny’s consequences.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the forest of Dwaita, the Pandavas in austere garments receive visiting Vedic sages beside a quiet lake and mountains.
The blind king Dhritarashtra sits in his court, trembling with grief as a Brahmana describes the suffering of the exiled Pandavas.
Bhima, powerful yet restrained, lies on the bare forest ground at night, fists clenched in anger while Draupadi and his brothers sleep nearby.
